//: Copy to config.json (or ~/.vibecoders/config.json). NON-SECRET settings only — keys live in the Keychain or .env. Everything here is optional; delete any block to take the default. Manage from the CLI: `vibecoders config set <dotted.key> <value>`.

features.//: Turn whole tool groups on/off. memory/reference/projectContext/tasks on; device/vault off (opt-in — they read personal data).

memory.//: The RAG knowledge graph. Lexical recall needs no keys. Embeddings are opt-in and use YOUR OWN provider key.

reference.//: Guards for the URL-study tools. Private/loopback hosts are refused unless you opt in here.

vault.//: Only used when features.vault is true. A directory of text notes, indexed read-only with the memory BM25 ranker.
